nodes.name: Solvothermal Co₂(OH)₃Cl synthesis
nodes.procedure: Add CoCl₂·6H₂O (0.3569 g, 1.5 mmol) and cetyltrimethylammonium bromide (CTAB, 0.5 g) to a mixed solution of deionized water (5 ml) and methanol (30 ml), then sonicate for 20 min to obtain clarification solution. The obtained clear solution was transferred into a 50 ml polytetrafluoroethylene autoclave. A piece of pre-treated nickel foam (1 cm × 1 cm) was immersed in it and reacted at 180°C for 24 h. The obtained catalyst was repeatedly washed with deionized water, and finally placed in a 60°C oven for 6 h to obtain Co₂(OH)₃Cl array.
nodes.source_text: 2.1.1. Synthesis of Co₂(OH)₃Cl array ... The typical synthesis method is slightly modified [40].

nodes.name: MOF ligand transformation
nodes.procedure: Firstly the o-aminoterephthalic acid (BDC-NH₂ 0.2182 g, 0.12 mmol) and DMF (4 ml) were put into a 15 ml reaction tube. After sonicating for 15 min, a clear solution was obtained. Then Co₂(OH)₃Cl array obtained in 2.1.1 was immersed in the above solution and reacted at 100°C for 24 h. The obtained catalyst was rinsed with deionized water several times, and finally placed in a 60°C oven for 6 h to obtain CoMOF-NH₂ lamella.
nodes.source_text: 2.1.2. Synthesis of CoMOF-NH₂ lamella ... Firstly the o-aminoterephthalic acid (BDC-NH₂ 0.2182 g, 0.12 mmol)...

nodes.name: Two-stage pyrolysis
nodes.procedure: The laminar CoMOF-NH₂ obtained in 2.1.2 was pyrolyzed under an argon atmosphere. The specific process is as follows: First, CoMOF-NH₂ is heated from room temperature to 300°C at a rate of 5°/min, and kept at 300°C for 1 h. Then it was heated from 300°C to 600°C at a rate of 1°C/min, and kept at 600°C for 3 h. Finally, the temperature was reduced to room temperature at a rate of -5°C/min (Fig.S2). The obtained product is referred to as Co₃O₄/NC nanosheet.

unit_operations.procedure_snippet: First, CoMOF-NH₂ is heated from room temperature to 300°C at a rate of 5°/min, and kept at 300°C for 1 h.

unit_operations.name: Final pyrolysis
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: Then it was heated from 300°C to 600°C at a rate of 1°C/min, and kept at 600°C for 3 h. Finally, the temperature was reduced to room temperature at a rate of -5°C/min.

nodes.source_text: 2.1.3. Synthesis of Co₃O₄/NC nanosheet ... The laminar CoMOF-NH₂ obtained in 2.1.2 was pyrolyzed under an argon atmosphere.
